definitions.gloss: entry into a country; immigration (at a border)
definitions.explanation: The act of entering a country, particularly the formal process of passing through immigration control at an airport or border crossing.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The immigration inspection took a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{入国|にゅうこく}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of countries you can enter without a visa is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いたら→着く：00680_tsuku⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you arrive at the airport, first line up at the immigration counter.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{入国|にゅうこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning "to enter a country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ} (immigration inspection)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{局|きょく} (immigration bureau)
- {入国|にゅうこく}⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧ (entry visa)
- {入国|にゅうこく}⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧ (refusal of entry)
- {入国|にゅうこく}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ (arrival/disembarkation card)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{入国|にゅうこく} (entering a country) vs. ⟦{出国|しゅっこく}→出国：15879_shukkoku⟧ (leaving a country) — these form a natural pair.
